degraded.description: Why the host is degraded: capacity 0 until an operator clears it.

ended_without_completion.description: The jobs that ended without a `completed` event of their source.

max_units.description: The most units of the host across its kinds; `null` is no cap.

no_tier_served.description:
No unit kind of the host meets the floor of any source: no source
gets an offer.

no_tier_served_causes.description:
Why no unit kind meets the floor: one entry for each kind of each
source. Absent when empty. [`Status::check`] refuses entries when
`no_tier_served` is false; a writer that knows no cause leaves the
list empty.

spooled_reports.description: The reports that a source refused, in the spool.

units.description: The units that run on the host now.

warm_units.description: The warm units of the host now, across its kinds, booting and ready.

Boundary.description:
The boundary between a job and the host, weakest first. `redirect`
rewrites file paths and is no isolation against hostile code.

Capability.description: The capability record of one unit kind (`unit-capability.v1`).

boundary_proof.description: The name of the proof of the boundary (a self-test, a probe), if any.

limits.description:
One mode for each limit (`wall`, `cpu`, `memory`, `pids`, `disk`). A
limit with no entry is `none`.

mount_modes.description: The modes of a mount that the unit can give: `rw`, `ro`.

net.description: The way out of the unit: `broker`, `none`, or `host`.

ContainerRoute.description: How a unit runs the containers of a job.

oneOf.description:
No container: a job that needs one is refused
(`container-not-supported`).
The container hooks of the runner (podrunner's call C2).

A container engine of the unit's own, inside its boundary: the runner
uses it as on a GitHub-hosted runner (`DOCKER_HOST` of a socket inside
the unit, never a socket of the host), for `services:`, `docker build`
and Dockerfile actions (T-553, PodUtils/podrunner#91).

CredentialStore.description: Where the credential files live while the unit runs.

oneOf.description: A directory of mode 0700 on the disk of the host.

EgressHold.description: How the network traffic of a unit reaches the egress broker.

oneOf.description: A redirect that a payload can go around.

Fact.description: A fact that is true, false or not known. `unknown` is read as false.

KindStatus.description: One unit kind in the status.

probe.description: The capability record of the kind (`unit-capability.v1`).

warm.description: The warm units of the kind; absent when the kind keeps none.

LimitMode.description: How the unit applies one limit.

NoTierCause.description:
One cause of `no_tier_served`: why a unit kind of a source does not meet
the floor of the source.

cause.description:
The boundary or the hold below the floor of the source, or the claim
that the start lowered, with its proof (for example
`guest-self-test-failed`).

fix.description: The missing key or flag, when the writer knows one; absent when not.

PinStatus.description: One pinned payload in the status.

Principal.description: Units and the control plane run as one uid (`shared`) or not.

SecretDelivery.description:
How a credential reaches the unit. There is no `env`: a credential never
goes into the environment.

credential_ages_s.description:
The age of the credential of each job that is not final, in
seconds, oldest first.

draining.description: An operator drained the source: it takes no new offer.

jobs.description: The jobs of the source in each state that is not final.

key_age_s.description:
The age of the key file of the source (the App key of
`github-scaleset`, the key of `remote`), from its time of change.
No value of the key is read.

refused.description: The refusals of the source, by code.

trust_unknown.description:
The offers whose trust inputs hold `unknown`: the source could not
read the run or the membership.

Tier.description:
The trust tier of a job. It comes from the trust inputs of an offer,
never from a label; `local` comes only from the configuration.

oneOf.description: A pull request from a fork.
A member job of a configured organization.

TreeKill.description: The kill of the whole process tree of a unit.

oneOf.description:
The conformance test of the tree kill (podrunner's test 3) passed
on this host.

WarmStatus.description:
The warm units of one kind: units that boot before a job and wait,
fresh, for one claim.

booting.description: The warm units that boot now.

paused_reason.description: Why the kind boots no new warm unit now; absent when it does.

ready.description: The warm units that wait for a claim now.

target.description: The warm units that the kind keeps.
